title: SKE Crystal Plus Watermelon Ice Pre-Filled Pods 20mg - 2 x Pods
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Watermelon Ice flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods deliver a burst of juicy, sweet and delicate Watermelon flavour with a dash of menthol for ultimate refreshment. The SKE Crystal Plus pod kit is the perfect choice for vapers who want a convenient, pocket-sized device for super-satisfying vaping on the go. It shares the colourful, radiant crystalline design of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar disposable vapes, but without the need to dispose of the whole device thanks to its compatibility with Crystal Plus pre-filled pods (sold separately), which are available in a variety of SKE’s most popular flavours. With the SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods, you can enjoy a variety of popular SKE Crystal flavours and an intensely satisfying MTL (Mouth-To-Lung) experience thanks to each pod’s 1.1ohm mesh coil. The prefilled design of these pods eliminates messy refills and maintenance, making vaping a hassle-free activity. Each SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pod contains 2ml of 20mg salt nicotine e-liquid, which delivers a smoother throat hit compared to standard freebase e-liquids. The nicotine salt formulation allows for a higher nicotine content, which is absorbed faster, providing rapid relief from nicotine cravings. And since the prefilled pods can be replaced when finished, the Crystal Plus Pod Kit offers a more sustainable alternative to disposable vapes without compromising on flavour or convenience. Please note: SKE Crystal Plus pods feature a special seal in the form of a bung that has to be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow to sit for 5-10 minutes. This allows the coil to properly saturate with e-liquid and prevents dry hits or burning out the coil.
